# Rust Development Digest — 2026-08-18

### Nexus Updates & Fixes
- Tagged Nexus-enabled servers with `nexuszone` (`^x`), hid zone servers from the server list (disabled via `nexus.hideZones`), and exposed Nexus info in A2S rules responses.
- Fixed the map button not enabling on the Nexus connect modal.
- Fixed Nexus map squishing.

### Livestock & Breeding
- Added the bull prefab setup.
- Fixed animals incorrectly set to female and added breeding finite state machine (FSM) states.

### Demo UI & Tooling
- Redid the demoui2 sandbox panel, added parenting, redid the colorpicker, and added keyframing for light intensity and range (developer tooling).

### Graphics & Rendering
- Fixed the underwater labs windows refraction texture with RRP.

### Code & Network Stability
- Captured exceptions thrown on worker threads inside async tasks to prevent silent failures.
- Fixed the battery `ReceiveAdditionalData` client RPC.
